name: Szentlászló (Hungary)
description: Light blue field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Szentlászló (a blue shield with Saint Ladislaus on horseback, a crescent and a star on a green mound) below a scroll inscribed SZENTLÁSZLÓ.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
